Q: Most efficient way to determine if a file exists only with a given extension A:

Make that


if [ "`find . -name '$i.[^A][^A][^E]*'`" = "" ] ;then
# ...
fi

as an explicit "cast" to string seems to be required by the = operator, and the rewritten regex corresponds to "anything matching file that doesn't have the extension AAE". I'm surprised though that '$i' works as expected, i.e. that the variable is expanded.

Q: How to mutate new variable according the formula string A:

Construct the entire mutate as a string and parse and evaluate it.

diamonds %>% 
  { eval(str2lang(sprintf("mutate(., %s)", my_formula2))) }

Q: How to pass a user / password in ansible command A:

For manual executions - If you use the -u <user> and --ask-pass options together in the ansible and ansible-playbook command lines, ansible will prompt you for the user and password you want to use. Neither will be saved to a file, and the password will be hidden when you type it in.

Since you are calling ansible from another script, however, you would need your script to be able to answer the password prompt during execution. Not sure how to code for that with python directly, but you could potentially wrap it in something like expect.

Q: Entity Framework Core: DbContextOptionsBuilder does not contain a definition for 'usesqlserver' and no extension method 'usesqlserver' A:

I managed to solve by adding the following via Nuget for C# version 10.

  • Add Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer

  • Add Microsoft.SqlServer.Server

  • Add Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore

If using multi-project solutions be sure to apply to project that will be using the import.

Q: Connecting 2 regular expressions doesn't work A:

If you do a fix-up on your regex a bit by allowing random text between your major captures by
adding a simple .*? your regex should match all cases.

(constraint\s+\w+\s+)*primary\s+key\s+(((on\s+conflict\s+\w+).*?\s+(autoincrement))|((autoincrement).*?\s+(on\s+conflict\s+\w+)))

https://regex101.com/r/7R0yAa/1

Formatted for clarity

( constraint \s+ \w+ \s+ )*               # (1)
primary \s+ key \s+ 
(                                         # (2 start)
   (                                         # (3 start)
      ( on \s+ conflict \s+ \w+ )               # (4)
      .*? \s+ 
      ( autoincrement )                         # (5)
   )                                         # (3 end)
 | 
   (                                         # (6 start)
      ( autoincrement )                         # (7)
      .*? \s+ 
      ( on \s+ conflict \s+ \w+ )               # (8)
   )                                         # (6 end)
)                                         # (2 end)

Q: Unable to locate the default servlet for serving static content. Please set the 'defaultServletName' property explicitly A:

You can add static servlet entry in webmvc-config.xml of spring application.

Given link has reference on how to set default servlet to refer at path /.

https://github.com/heroku/java-spring-sample/blob/master/src/main/webapp/WEB-INF/spring/webmvc-config.xml
